scope: One new guarded CLI run with ChangesItemReorder.LEADT one-to-three at h10.5, after the accepted E15/I07 h10 stock-based order starts and before its original h11 delivery. Reuse accepted I07.var01 h5-change and E15 explicit-three raw evidence as comparators; do not rerun them.

source.manual_boundary: A scheduled ChangesItemReorder update changes the existing ItemReorder settings. An order already started keeps its own delivery time; a later order uses the updated lead. The native log may show order start and completion without separately printing change application.

frozen_delta: Against accepted I07.var01 change-input, only shared description and ChangesItemReorder.TIMEC 5 to 10.5 differ. All business inputs, including LEADT three in the scheduled row, initial ItemReorder.LEADT one, demand, stock and random seed are unchanged.

predeclared_gates: Independent pre-run review confirms the accepted comparator bytes, exact source delta, manual boundary, unique run ID and guarded runner before the native call.

Before calculation, the pinned checker exactly compares all 22 authored row-containing tables with native export. Calculation and selected ItemResults export then require converter Errors0/Warnings1 (#108 only)/Notes0 and valid nonempty native outputs.

The h10 depot demand and one two-unit order begin before the h10.5 change; the existing order still completes and delivers physical DU IDs 5 and 6 at h11 under its original one-hour lead. There is no new order or physical movement at h10.5.
The accepted h5 I07.var01 changed arm delivers its otherwise matched order at h13 under three-hour lead. Compare accepted raw event and selected results by byte pins without rerunning it.

Reconcile every one of 72 half-hour selected depot bins, full physical stock snapshots, order start/completion/arrival, base shipment, outstanding interval, backorder and terminal stock. Mission, system and aggregate stock results should remain matched within the declared contrast.
If the order delivery changes to h13, a source pin or native ledger differs, or the prior h5 comparator cannot be verified, seal the run as diagnostic and do not publish a positive retention claim.
limits: One fixed seed, one existing stock-based order and one mid-flight LEADT change. No new post-change order is induced, so this run alone does not demonstrate changed settings on a later order; that fact comes from the accepted I07.var01 h5 comparator.
No time-based ROINT cycle, random lead, two outstanding orders, tie-time change, other depot, GUI behavior, cross-engine equivalence or full I07/Issue #18 claim.
